## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 1, 2026 - Sep 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Yana London_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "Consistently poor experiences and cancellations- not worth the risk. I bought expensive top-up credits, the provider cancelled the appointment and it was not available to rebook, but ClassPass refused to refund the top-up credit. The support repeatedly misunderstood the issue and made incorrect claims and ignored my request to escalate to supervisor"
            2. _bllllllllll111_, Sep 2, 2026, 1/5: "I had a 14 day free trial and halfway through (approx 5-6 days in) it changed all the availability to make businesses only available if I upgraded so I was unable to use 14 of my 36 credits. Seems very misleading and a way of forcing people into feeling as though they have to pay. Not a fan of the lack of transparency at all."
            3. _Olsen Ivanolsen_, Aug 21, 2026, 1/5: "They offer free trial and when it ends they’ll start charging you the full price without any notifications. You’ll also won’t see it in Apple subscriptions. The user flow to cancel subscription is hidden and complicated. And they won’t give you a refund even if you didn’t use the app."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Mar 14, 2026 - Sep 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Z3820_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "I just downloaded the latest ClassPass update and now the app does not work at all. I tried shutting down my phone and restarting it but all I see is the spinning wheel of death and I cannot search for any classes. What happened, ClassPass?!?! You made your app completely unusable."
            2. _mattallsop_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
            3. ___Mari__, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
<!--/ir-theme-->
